description: Next.js 15 App Router shell (delivery spec §6.3 M2): the SDS top-bar menubar with the 44-entry screen map (unbuilt screens carry EMPTY tags), the two-axis status language bound fail-closed to the engine's displayStatus/supplyStatus through packages/ui, and the HTTP transport for the engine-live run (POST /api/plan — one tenant-scoped transaction with a transaction-local app.tenant_id GUC, the shared pg adapter injected into plan-service, receipts mapped 200/400/422/500). Transport only: request semantics live in plan-service; rendering primitives live in packages/ui (A12).
